bibl.title: P.Oxy. VI 866: A Fragment of Comedy or Historical Prose?
bibl.seg: Nikoletta Kanavou, P.Oxy. VI 866: A Fragment of Comedy or Historical Prose?
bibl.note: P. Oxy. VI, 866 (= MP3 1297.3; LDAB 2611). The extreme brevity of the fragment means that its genre cannot be determined with certainty, but verbal similarities between it and passages from Hellenistic and Imperial prose writers suggest a better case for the fragment's assignment to a piece of historical prose rather than to a Menandrian play.
